newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan PM says Nomura case blow to industry - Kyodo.
newsitem.headline: Japan PM says Nomura case blow to industry - Kyodo.

text.p: Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto said on Friday the arrest of a former head of giant brokerage Nomura Securities Co Ltd would have a severe effect on the country's securities industry, Kyodo news agency reported.

Commenting on the arrest earlier on Friday of Hideo Sakamaki, who was president of Nomura Securities until a scandal over racketeer payoffs broke in March, Kyodo quoted Hashimoto as telling reporters:
"It is not important whether or not he was arrested. What matters is that the leader of a top-ranking company has caused a problem like this."
"The impact this will have (on the securities industry) is more severe than you think it is," Hashimoto added.

Sakamaki, 61, was arrested by prosecutors on suspicion of conspiring with other former Nomura executives to pay off a racketeer in order to prevent any disruption of the company's annual shareholders' meeting.
